payload.text: (2026-10-25, hv by relay from molt-vc's session) Intent's pushes to local and upstream are covered: hv answered "Push all now" by TUI at 18:36Z on devbin's todo 147, whose list names Intent local and upstream; "(b)" in devbin-vc's session, authorising devbin-vc to run them; and afterwards "That kind of thing, really isn't an issue. Just push on." devbin-vc runs Intent's two pushes, fast-forward only and never --no-verify, once Intent's pre-push hook passes, which needs the installed pair rebuilt at HEAD (vc's build all in its ordinary place at molt-vc's desk; the push is not a priority over the queue). vc tells devbin-vc by name at the build all's END. A release and its tag remain hv's at the terminal.
